title: Cutout 솔로 #035 · powerlifter bombshell · 컷아웃 롱 아이보리 · 손 허리 · 항구 등대 · 글래스 스킨
prompt:
Professional fashion photograph, full body shot. ONE woman standing.

THE ABSOLUTE DARKEST BLACK SKIN ON EARTH blue-black void complexion darker than night sky, mid 30s goddess, powerlifter bombshell physique THE MOST EXTREME PHYSICALLY POSSIBLE beyond all anatomy limits — immense powerful thighs and shoulders built with real strength, a thick solid waist, overwhelming muscular bulk layered with soft curves everywhere, waist-length braids deep burgundy hair — wearing a sleek floor-length ivory jersey gown with large cutouts at both sides of the waist, narrow straps crossing the torso and a high leg slit up to the hip, hugging every curve. Pose: one hand on her waist, the other lifted to her chin, weight on one leg — most extreme powerlifter bombshell silhouette ever displayed.
Footwear: heels of the most absurdly extreme height imaginable, platform stiletto ballet boots made of glossy ivory, each with a razor-thin tapered heel a full forty inches tall and a twelve-inch hidden front platform, her feet arched fully vertical on the very tips of her toes like a dancer on pointe, her legs stretched impossibly long and her whole body lifted far above the ground on them as if standing on stilts.
Nails: the longest nails physically imaginable, ballerina nails each longer than her middle finger, in glossy ivory with a high polish.
Jewelry: heavy gold rings on every finger, a delicate silver body chain draped across her collarbones and down her torso, and a pearl choker and a long strand of pearls hanging low on her chest. Jewelry is metal and pearl only, worn on the body, nothing added to her face or ears.
Face: her face is bare of any garment — real living flesh with real pores, a soft sheen of natural oils and bright real catchlights, the face of a real Black woman with strong, striking features, a broad nose and full lips, an unmistakably feminine face with a calm, composed expression, makeup: very dewy glass skin with a strong luminous highlight on the cheekbones, nose bridge and forehead, a rosy blush, glossy coral lips.

Background: a sunny harbour quay of pale stone with a waist-high iron railing, mooring posts of normal height and a white lighthouse behind her, under a soft overcast sky with gentle diffused light, bright and evenly lit, shadows soft, the whole floor and surroundings clearly visible and in focus, NO dark background NO black void. ONE woman only. Extreme macro detail on the fabric texture, the skin and the shadows. Full-length wide shot from a moderate distance with the camera at waist height, the whole figure from the soles of the boots to the top of her head completely visible, with the door, railing or steps beside her at normal human scale so the extreme heel height reads at a glance, the towering heels clearly separating the boot soles from the floor. 8K portrait 2:3 aspect ratio.
